proposals.rationale: By design: guardlink clear exists to reset a project's annotations, and the operator already holds shell write access to the very tree it rewrites, so this is no privilege gain. Gate: dry-run preview, then a y/N prompt, then a hard refusal when stdin is not a TTY and --yes was not passed, at src/cli/index.ts:1071

proposals.rationale: By design: guardlink mcp exists to hand a connected coding agent the threat model — that disclosure is the product, not a leak. No privilege gain either: the agent already reads the annotated source these records are parsed from, so the assembled model tells it nothing it could not derive itself. Authorization is the channel: the server is stdio-only with no network listener, so the only client is the process the operator launched, at src/mcp/index.ts:23
